profiles.purpose: Preserve the measured all-GPU Stage 7 baseline when current memory safely fits.
Reduce context, batch, and GPU residency while retaining most layers on the GPU.
Trade latency for substantially lower VRAM demand under device pressure.
Run without GPU offload when GPU telemetry or usable VRAM is unavailable.

selection_notes: Profile values are experimental hypotheses, not claimed optima.
Performance preserves the exact measured Stage 7 configuration.
Balanced uses roughly seventy percent GPU-layer residency and seventy-five percent context.
Constrained uses fewer than one-third GPU layers and half the baseline context.
Every selected profile is re-estimated against one fresh hardware snapshot before scheduling.
CPU-safe explicitly uses --device none because zero GPU layers alone still initialized CUDA memory.
